name: cropx/segments
title: Segments
description: Three-column audience segment block (Enterprise / Service Providers / On-Farm). Deep Blue background with drift animation. Desktop: 3-column grid. Mobile: WAI-ARIA tabbed interface with accent-color indicators per segment.

enterpriseBody.default: Get real-time visibility into field conditions across hundreds of farms with our Enterprise Solutions — enabling smarter procurement decisions, EUDR compliance, and measurable sustainability outcomes at scale.

serviceBody.default: See precision soil and climate data across every client farm with our Service Provider Solutions — so you can spend less time on manual reporting and more time on the insights that drive outcomes for your growers.

onFarmBody.default: From irrigation scheduling to soil health monitoring — our On-Farm Solutions deliver real-time data so you can cut input costs and improve yields season after season.
